_note: Nomination patterns (task 8.2), Documentary: made-up films over three finished seasons (2014-2016, 10 shortlisted films and 5 nominees each) and a live 2017 before its shortlist. The expected values were worked out by hand from the plan's Phase 8 notes; see _workings. Rates are to 4 decimals, % as shown (rounded).
_workings: Smoothed rate = (hits + 5*base) / (count + 5). Base is 5/10 for 2015 (from 2014), 10/20 for 2016, 15/30 for 2017: 0.5 each time, so rate = (hits + 2.5) / (count + 5). Strong: count >= 6 and rate >= 0.6.

Results count when announced before that season's Oscar nominations day. 2014's Cinema Eye (C) results have no dates: they count. B4's IDA (I) win was announced after the 2015 nominations day (its nominations before): it counts as a nomination. B10's Spirit (S) nomination was announced after: it doesn't count. A3 is US and GB (not US-only); A9 has no countries (not US-only).
2015 learns from 2014: NS 5 of 6 -> 7.5/11 = 0.6818, strong. LA 4 of 4 -> 0.7222 but only 4 films (under the 6-film floor). F 2 of 6 -> 0.4091. Strong: NS only.
2016 learns from 2014-15: NS 7/9 0.6786, LA 6/7 0.7083 (crosses the floor: now strong), S 7/8 0.7308, C 6/6 0.7727 -> strong. D 5/5 0.75 and I 3/3 0.6875 are under the floor.
2017 learns from 2014-16: C 8/8 0.8077, S 10/11 0.7813, D 8/9 0.75 (crosses the floor), LA 8/10 0.70, NS 10/13 0.6944 strong; I 5/5 0.75 under the floor.

Busy = the five most-nominated, ties at fifth included. 2014: counts 6,5,5,4,4,4,... -> six busy (A1 A2 A6 A3 A4 A7). 2015: 5,5,4,4,4,4,... -> six (B1 B6 B2 B3 B4 B7). 2016: 6,5,4,4,4,3,... -> five (C6 C1 C2 C3 C7). 2017: 5,5,4,3,3,2,... -> five (D1 D2 D3 D5 D9).
Snub rule's films (busy, no S and no I): 2014 A4 (in), A6, A7; 2015 B6, B7; 2016 C6, C7. Figures: 1 of 3 for 2015 (rate 3.5/8 = 0.4375), 1 of 5 for 2016 (0.35), 1 of 7 for 2017 (3.5/12 = 0.2917).
Critics' sweep (2+ of NY, LA, NS; none of D, C, I): 2014 A3 (in), A6; 2015 B6, B8; 2016 C6, C8 (in). Figures 1 of 2 for 2015, 1 of 4 for 2016 (both 'few films').
Filmmakers' reason (outside the busy five, with D, C or S): 2014 A9 (missed); 2015 B5 (in); 2016 C4 (in), C5. Figures 0 of 1 for 2015, 1 of 2 for 2016, 2 of 4 for 2017.

2015 patterns (strong NS): 1 not-US 3/3 0.6875; 1 US 2/3 0.5625; 0 not-US 0/1 0.4167; 0 US 0/3 0.3125. B6 (1 US, busy, no S/I) is marked down from 0.5625 to 0.4375; B7 (0 US, 0.3125) matches the rule but its pattern rate is already lower. Ranking: B1 .6875, B2 .5625, B6 .4375, then 0.4167: B3 (4 nominations), B5 and B8 tie (0 strong, 3 nominations) -> by title B5 takes the fifth pick, B8 sixth; B10; then 0.3125: B4 and B7 tie on 4 -> B4, B7, B9. Picks B1 B2 B6 B3 B5: 4 of 5 (B4, a nominee, is 8th). Without the snub rule B6 (0.5625) passes B2 on nominations: same five, 4 of 5.
2015 %: rates add to 206/48; scaled to 5: B1 165/206 = 80%, B2 66%, B6 51%, 0.4167 films 49%, 0.3125 films 36%. All five nominees have at most one strong award: 5 underdogs.

2016 patterns (strong C LA NS S): 3+ not-US 3/3 0.6875; 3+ US 3/3 0.6875; 2 not-US 1/1 0.5833; 2 US 1/1 0.5833; 1 not-US 1/3 0.4375; 1 US 0/2 0.3571; 0 not-US 1/2 0.5; 0 US 0/5 0.25. C6 (2 US 0.5833, busy, no S/I) is marked down to 0.35. Ranking: C1 (4 strong), C2 (3 strong), C10 0.5, C3 0.4375 (4 nominations), C4 and C8 tie (1 strong, 3 nominations) -> C4 5th, C8 6th; C6 0.35; 0.25: C7 (4), C5 and C9 tie -> C5, C9. Picks C1 C2 C10 C3 C4: 4 of 5 (C8, a nominee, is 6th). Without the snub rule C6 is 3rd and the picks get 3.

Snub risk: 2015 B6 (both signs), B7 (busy), B8 (sweep); 2016 C6 (both), C7 (busy), C8 (sweep, got in anyway). 2017 is before its shortlist: no flags, no %. Flagged films got in 1 of 6; underdogs 8 of 10 nominees.

2017 patterns (strong C D LA NS S): 3+ not-US 5/5 0.75; 3+ US 4/4 0.7222; 2 not-US 2/2 0.6429; 2 US 1/2 0.5; 1 not-US 3/5 0.55; 1 US 0/3 0.3125; 0 not-US 0/2 0.3571; 0 US 0/7 0.2083. D2 (0.3125) and D9 (0.3571) are busy with no S/I: marked down to 0.2917; D3 has I. Ranking: D1, D3, D5, D6, D2 (1 strong), D9 (0), D7 and D8 tie (2 nominations) -> D7, D8, D4. Outside chances: picks 6-8.
Backtest 2015-2016: 8 of 10 with the snub rule, 7 of 10 without.

Best predictors over 2014-2016 (30 films, 15 nominees, 50%; warning at 55% or less), patterns by the strong awards learned from all three: near-certain C 8/8, S 10/11, D 8/9; best all-round LA 8/10 (caught 8/15), NS 10/13, not US-only 10/14; wide nets F 8/19 (caught 8/15); warning signs 0 strong US-only 0/7, CC 0/6, G 2/15, the snub rule's films 1/7, NY 2/9, US-only 5/16. Under 6 films, not shown: I 5/5, every win, the other patterns.
